Platform Owner.Title: Data Extraction and Database Creation
Platform Owner.Description: Develop functionality to extract first-level contact information from the platform owner's LinkedIn and Facebook profiles, including personal and professional details to form a comprehensive database.

User Stories.Title: Authenticate Platform Owner's Social Media Access
User Stories.Description: As a Platform Owner, I want the ability to securely authenticate my LinkedIn and Facebook accounts so that the system can access my first-level contact information without compromising my login credentials.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system should provide an OAuth login for LinkedIn and Facebook.
Authentication must be secure and follow best practices for OAuth implementations.
The system should only request permissions necessary for accessing first-level contact information.

User Stories.Title: Extract Contact Information
User Stories.Description: As a Platform Owner, I want to extract first-level contact details from LinkedIn and Facebook so that I can build a comprehensive database of my professional and personal contacts.
AcceptanceCriteria: Contact information should include name, email, job title, company, and social profile URLs.
The extraction process must handle pagination to ensure all contacts are retrieved.
Contacts must be deduplicated across both platforms.
Extracted data should be validated to ensure accuracy and completeness.

User Stories.Title: Store Contact Information Locally
User Stories.Description: As a Platform Owner, I want to store the extracted contact information locally in JSON format so that I can ensure data privacy and security.
AcceptanceCriteria: Extracted data should be stored in a structured JSON format.
Data storage should occur on the local machine or a designated secure local server.
The JSON file should include clear, human-readable labels for each data field.

User Stories.Title: Manual Data Backup Process
User Stories.Description: As a Platform Owner, I want to manually initiate a backup of the contact database so that I can prevent data loss.
AcceptanceCriteria: There should be an option in the interface to manually trigger a backup.
Backup should create a timestamped copy of the JSON data file.
The system should verify the integrity of the backup file after completion.

User Stories.Title: View and Edit Contact Information
User Stories.Description: As a Platform Owner, I want to view and edit the details of my stored contacts so that I can ensure the information is current and accurate.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system should provide a GUI to display contact details.
Editing functionality should allow modifying all stored fields of contact information.
Changes should be saved immediately to the local JSON file.

Platform Owner.Title: Data Enhancement Using AI
Platform Owner.Description: Utilize OpenAI transformers to enhance the extracted data by analyzing and enriching contact profiles with additional details such as personal interests, family information, activities, and travel history.

User Stories.Title: Profile Enrichment with Personal Interests
User Stories.Description: As a Platform Owner, I want the system to use OpenAI transformers to analyze each contact's social media activities and enrich their profiles with identified personal interests, so that I can better understand their preferences and tailor my marketing approaches accordingly.
AcceptanceCriteria: System extracts data points related to personal interests from social media platforms.
OpenAI transformers analyze text to identify and catalog interests within the contact's profile.
Updated profiles are saved with new personal interest data in the local database.
Platform owner can review enriched data on a user interface.

User Stories.Title: Addition of Family Information to Profiles
User Stories.Description: As a Platform Owner, I want the system to enrich contact profiles with family information such as marital status and children, so that I can create more personalized marketing messages that resonate with the contact's family dynamics.
AcceptanceCriteria: System identifies mentions of family-related information from social media posts and profile details.
OpenAI transformers interpret and classify family information accurately.
Contact profiles are updated with family information in the local database.
Platform owner can view these updates on the system's GUI.

User Stories.Title: Incorporation of Activity and Interest Data
User Stories.Description: As a Platform Owner, I want the system to automatically extract and integrate data about contacts’ activities such as events attended and hobbies from social media, using OpenAI transformers to ensure relevance and accuracy, so that I can better segment and target my outreach.
AcceptanceCriteria: Automatic extraction of activity-related information from social media.
Data is processed and verified using AI to ensure it reflects current interests.
Activity data is accurately incorporated into the existing contact profiles.
Profiles with updated activity information are accessible to the platform owner.

User Stories.Title: Travel History Analysis
User Stories.Description: As a Platform Owner, I want the system to analyze and record the travel history of my contacts by interpreting posts and check-ins, so that I can offer travel-related products or services more effectively.
AcceptanceCriteria: Extraction of relevant travel-related posts and check-ins.
Use of OpenAI transformers to analyze and interpret travel data.
Travel history is added to the contact's profile in the local database.
Platform owner has the ability to view and utilize this enriched travel information.

User Stories.Title: Profile Matching and List Generation
User Stories.Description: As a Platform Owner, I want the system to match the enriched profiles against the characteristics of the products or services I wish to promote, so that I can generate a curated list of contacts most likely to be interested.
AcceptanceCriteria: System uses enhanced profiles to match with input product/service characteristics.
Generation of a detailed list of matching contacts based on profile similarities and product/service features.
Curated lists are accessible and can be exported by the platform owner for outreach.
Ensure high accuracy in matching to maximize outreach potential.

Platform Owner.Title: Data Analysis for Matching
Platform Owner.Description: Analyze the enhanced data to identify potential targets for specific products or services based on their profiles and interests, as defined by the platform owner.

User Stories.Title: User Story: Input Product or Service Details
User Stories.Description: As a Platform Owner, I want to input details of a specific product or service, so that these can be used to find matching profiles in the contact database.
AcceptanceCriteria: A simple GUI input field for product/service details is provided.
The input allows textual descriptions up to a specified character limit.
The system confirms receipt of the input data.

User Stories.Title: User Story: AI-Driven Profile Generation
User Stories.Description: As a Platform Owner, I want the system to use AI to generate a profile for the input product or service, so that this profile accurately represents the target audience characteristics.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system uses OpenAI transformers to process input data.
Generated profiles include demographics, interests, and other relevant attributes.
The profile generation process completes within a reasonable time frame.

User Stories.Title: User Story: Match Profiles with Contact Database
User Stories.Description: As a Platform Owner, I want the system to match the generated product/service profile with profiles in the enhanced contact database, so that I can identify potential targets efficiently.
AcceptanceCriteria: The matching process uses attributes such as interests, demographics, and activities.
The system displays the percentage match for potential contacts.
Only contacts matching above a specified threshold are included in the results.

User Stories.Title: User Story: Generate Curated Contact Lists
User Stories.Description: As a Platform Owner, I want the system to generate a list of contacts that match the product/service profile, so that I can target them with tailored marketing efforts.
AcceptanceCriteria: The list includes contact name, social media profiles, and matching percentage.
Contacts are sorted by relevance based on the matching percentage.
The system allows exporting the list to an Excel file.

User Stories.Title: User Story: Export Contact Lists
User Stories.Description: As a Platform Owner, I want to be able to export the generated contact lists into an Excel file, so that I can use them for outreach or further analysis externally.
AcceptanceCriteria: Export functionality is easily accessible in the GUI.
The Excel file contains all relevant details of the contacts.
The export process is secure and completes without data loss.

User Stories.Title: User Story: View Detailed Contact Profiles
User Stories.Description: As a Platform Owner, I want to view detailed profiles of potential contacts from the curated list, so that I can understand their backgrounds and interests before making contact.
AcceptanceCriteria: Detailed profiles can be accessed by clicking on contact names in the list.
Profiles include enriched data such as interests, family information, and activities.
The interface for viewing profiles is user-friendly and displays all relevant information comprehensively.

Platform Owner.Title: Generation of Curated Contact Lists
Platform Owner.Description: Generate curated lists of contacts likely interested in the specific product or service offerings inputted by the platform owner, including contact details and relevant social media profiles.

User Stories.Title: Contact Data Extraction
User Stories.Description: As a Platform Owner, I want to extract first-level contact information from my LinkedIn and Facebook profiles so that I can build a database of potential leads.
AcceptanceCriteria: Successfully extract names, emails, and social media URLs from LinkedIn and Facebook.
Ensure data is extracted only from first-level connections to maintain privacy and relevance.
System should handle permissions and authentication required for accessing LinkedIn and Facebook data.

User Stories.Title: AI-Driven Data Enhancement
User Stories.Description: As a Platform Owner, I want to use AI to enhance the extracted contact data with additional personal details so that I can create detailed profiles for more effective targeting.
AcceptanceCriteria: AI uses OpenAI transformers to analyze social media activity and add data such as interests and activities to contact profiles.
Enhanced data includes actionable insights like family status, interests, and recent activities.
Ensure the AI processing respects privacy norms and only uses publicly available data.

User Stories.Title: Product and Service Input
User Stories.Description: As a Platform Owner, I want to input details about the products or services I am promoting so that the system can identify relevant contacts.
AcceptanceCriteria: System allows easy input of product/service details through a simple GUI.
Input data includes product descriptions, target demographics, and any special requirements.
GUI confirms successful data entry with an acknowledgment message.

User Stories.Title: Contact Matching and List Generation
User Stories.Description: As a Platform Owner, I want the system to match my product and service offerings with the enhanced profiles so that I can receive a curated list of potentially interested contacts.
AcceptanceCriteria: System processes input product/service details and matches them with contact profiles using AI.
Generate lists that include contact details and relevance scores based on potential interest in the offering.
Allow the platform owner to review and modify the generated lists before finalizing.

User Stories.Title: Export Curated Contact Lists
User Stories.Description: As a Platform Owner, I want the ability to export the curated lists of contacts to Excel so that I can utilize them for outreach efforts.
AcceptanceCriteria: Export function includes all relevant contact details and any additional notes or tags from the analysis.
Excel files are formatted for easy reading and further manipulation if required.
Ensure the export process is secure and maintains the confidentiality of the contact data.

User Stories.Title: Local Data Storage and Backup
User Stories.Description: As a Platform Owner, I want all data to be stored locally and have robust backup processes so that I can ensure data security and availability.
AcceptanceCriteria: Data stored in non-encrypted JSON files locally on the platform owner's device.
System provides a manual backup option and instructions for the platform owner to secure data.
Alerts the platform owner of successful or failed backup attempts.

Platform Owner.Title: Local Data Storage and Management
Platform Owner.Description: Ensure all data is stored locally in JSON files to prioritize privacy and security, with the platform owner responsible for data backup and maintenance.

User Stories.Title: Secure Local Data Storage
User Stories.Description: As a Platform Owner, I want all data to be stored in local JSON files so that I can ensure the privacy and security of sensitive information.
AcceptanceCriteria: Data is stored in JSON format on the local machine.
No data is stored or transferred to cloud services.
All stored data must be accessible only through the application.

User Stories.Title: Data Backup System
User Stories.Description: As a Platform Owner, I want to implement a manual backup system so that I can securely back up data to prevent loss.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system provides an option to manually initiate data backups.
Backups must be stored in a secure location specified by the Platform Owner.
The system must confirm successful completion of backups.

User Stories.Title: Data Integrity Check
User Stories.Description: As a Platform Owner, I want the system to perform routine integrity checks on the stored data so that I can trust the data's accuracy and completeness.
AcceptanceCriteria: Integrity checks are performed automatically at set intervals.
Any issues detected during checks are logged and reported to the Platform Owner.
The system can recover corrupted data from the latest backup if integrity checks fail.

User Stories.Title: Secure Data Access
User Stories.Description: As a Platform Owner, I want the system to require authentication for accessing the local data storage so that unauthorized access is prevented.
AcceptanceCriteria: Access to the JSON files is gated by authentication requiring a username and password.
The system logs all access attempts, successful or failed.
Multiple failed access attempts result in a temporary lockout to prevent brute-force attacks.

User Stories.Title: Data Export Functionality
User Stories.Description: As a Platform Owner, I want the ability to export data from JSON files to Excel so that I can easily review and manipulate the data outside the system.
AcceptanceCriteria: Exported data must reflect the current state of the JSON files.
The system provides options for selecting specific data fields for export.
Exported Excel files are stored locally and are not emailed or uploaded to cloud services.

User Stories.Title: Local Data Deletion Protocol
User Stories.Description: As a Platform Owner, I want a secure method to delete outdated or unnecessary data from the local storage without affecting integrity so that I can manage storage space and maintain data relevancy.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system allows for selective deletion of data entries.
Deletion actions require confirmation from the Platform Owner to proceed.
The system logs all deletion activities for audit purposes.

Platform Owner.Title: User Interface Development
Platform Owner.Description: Develop a simple graphical user interface (GUI) that allows the platform owner to input product or service details, view the generated contact lists, and export these lists to an Excel file.

User Stories.Title: Input Product/Service Details
User Stories.Description: As a Platform Owner, I want to input details of products or services into the GUI so that I can specify the offerings for which I need targeted contact lists.
AcceptanceCriteria: A form is provided in the GUI to input product or service details.
The form must include fields for all necessary attributes like name, description, and any specific filters or criteria.
Input data is validated for correctness and completeness before being accepted.

User Stories.Title: View Generated Contact Lists
User Stories.Description: As a Platform Owner, I want to be able to view the generated contact lists on the GUI so that I can review and verify the contacts selected based on my input details.
AcceptanceCriteria: The GUI displays the list of contacts in a readable and organized format.
The list includes essential contact details such as name, email, and social profile links.
The GUI provides an option to refresh or regenerate the list based on the same or modified input criteria.

User Stories.Title: Export Contact Lists to Excel
User Stories.Description: As a Platform Owner, I want an option to export the generated contact lists to an Excel file so that I can use them for outreach or other business processes outside the platform.
AcceptanceCriteria: A clear and accessible option to export the contact list to Excel is available in the GUI.
The exported file must preserve the organization and formatting of the data displayed in the GUI.
The export process should handle large data sets efficiently, ensuring a quick response time and minimal disruption.

User Stories.Title: Secure Local Data Handling
User Stories.Description: As a Platform Owner, I want the software to handle data securely in the local system without transmitting it over the internet so that I can maintain control over the privacy of my data.
AcceptanceCriteria: All data inputs and outputs are handled locally within the GUI, with no data sent to or stored in the cloud.
The system has provisions for local data backup and recovery in case of data loss.
The design adheres to best practices for secure data handling and storage.

User Stories.Title: Simple and Intuitive User Interface
User Stories.Description: As a Platform Owner, I want the GUI to be simple and intuitive so that I can easily navigate and use the software without requiring extensive training or technical support.
AcceptanceCriteria: The user interface is clean, with a clear layout and minimalistic design.
All functionalities (input, view, export) are easily accessible from the main interface.
The system provides helpful hints or tooltips as necessary to guide the user through various tasks.
